derivedFrom: the four captured fundamentals payloads read by hand, not from a run. Each name's forward rate, last ex-dividend date and count of dividends in each year are the SplitsDividends section's ForwardAnnualDividendRate, ExDividendDate and NumberDividendsByYear as filed: AAPL and MSFT each file 24 years ending in 2026's three, 2025 their last whole year at four; KEYS and NFLX file a rate of 0, no ex-date and no year's count. The night keeps the part beside the company row each storing fetch writes, so a fetch that read another section, dropped a year or kept the pay date for the ex-date would read differently here.
